subject: Sponsor pre-roll rights, multi-region RTMP keys & producer runbook
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@brightsparkmarketing.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Sponsor assets + pre-roll permission for Oct 29 webinar

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for letting BrightSpark sponsor the Oct 29 webinar. A couple of quick asks so we can prep our creative and legal: 

1) We want to run a 15s pre-roll (no audio besides a 1s stinger) before the main stream begins. Is that allowed under Redwood’s standard sponsor policy?
2) We need short-term access to the recording (editable MP4) to cut 30–60s social clips. We’d request a 30-day window of access after the event.
3) For streaming keys: we’re sending an encoder team from EMEA — can we confirm RTMP endpoints/keys for the EU region and also a fallback to the US region if there’s a failover?

Attaching our sponsor rider and a high-level shot list. Happy to hop on a quick call this week to finalize.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Head of Events, BrightSpark Marketing
[attachment: brightspark_sponsor_rider.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@brightsparkmarketing.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Sponsor assets + pre-roll permission for Oct 29 webinar

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the note and the rider. Quick answers up front:
- Pre-roll: we can support a 15s pre-roll delivered as an H.264 MP4. Producer team will need the final file by Oct 27 10:00 PT to run ingest and QA. No audio is preferred but a 1s stinger is OK. We will not alter sponsors’ creative unless it violates our guidelines (no misleading claims).
- Recording access: We can provide the post-event MP4 for 30 days but need a signed addendum to the sponsorship terms that limits use to promotional/social clips and credits Redwood. Legal will draft; Marissa can send DocuSign.
- RTMP/failover: Ben — can you confirm EU RTMP endpoints and produce an RTMP key matrix for Samantha’s encoder team? Also list the health-check window and expected cutover time if we fail to US.

Laura and Ben, looping you in for runbook and QA windows. Samantha, attaching our producer runbook v1 and Ben’s checklist will follow.

Evelyn Hart
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: producer_runbook_v1.docx (DOCX, 95KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@brightsparkmarketing.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Sponsor assets + pre-roll permission for Oct 29 webinar

On Thu, Oct 20, 2026 at 11:04 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Laura and Ben, looping you in for runbook and QA windows. Samantha, attaching our producer runbook v1 and Ben’s checklist will follow.

Hi all —

Attached RTMP key matrix (also pasted below) with region-specific endpoints. Samantha — we’ll create short-lived keys for the BrightSpark encoder accounts that expire Nov 30. We’ll also configure continuous health pings and a 45s automatic failover to the US cluster if packet loss > 7% for three consecutive checks.

RTMP key matrix (summary):
- eu1.redwoodstream.com: rtmp://eu1.redwoodstream.com/live | key: brs-eu-10-XXXXX
- us1.redwoodstream.com: rtmp://us1.redwoodstream.com/live | key: brs-us-10-YYYYY (fallback)

Pre-roll ingestion notes:
- Deliver MP4 (H.264, 1920x1080, 30fps, max 15s). No alpha channel.
- Filename: BRIGHTSPARK_PR_v1.mp4. Submit to: https://uploads.redwood.ai/event-assets/rdw-q4 (we’ll provide upload token).
- Ingest deadline: 2026-10-27T10:00:00-07:00 (PT).

QA window plan (producer):
- Oct 28 09:00–11:00 PT: dry run (ingest -> playout)
- Oct 29 08:30–09:00 PT: final check (pre-roll + live handoff)

Attachments: rtmp_key_matrix.csv

Ben Carter
Technical Producer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: rtmp_key_matrix.csv (CSV, 2KB)]
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@brightsparkmarketing.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Sponsor assets + pre-roll permission for Oct 29 webinar

Thanks everyone — this all looks good. Quick confirmations:
- We’ll upload BRIGHTSPARK_PR_v1.mp4 to the upload link by Oct 27 07:30 PT.
- Our legal team will sign the short addendum; please send DocuSign to legal@brightsparkmarketing.com.
- We confirm the encoder will use the EU key and have a shadow connection to US fallback for redundancy.

Appreciate the detailed failover plan and the 30-day access. If anything changes on our side I’ll ping Marissa immediately. See you at the dry run on Oct 28.

Best,
Samantha
